verdict.rationale: Mastra's MCP events let code `.emit()` and `.subscribe()` to events, and the docs state each event can start a workflow run. Mastra also routes webhook or polling events into notification signals for agent threads. However, triggering is wired in subscribe handlers in code rather than shown as declarative, and webhook routing targets agent threads rather than workflows. missing for 10: declarative trigger configuration for workflows, documented fan-out of one event to many functions, queue-sourced triggers, webhook-to-workflow triggering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, events from my app, webhooks, or queues trigger workflows declaratively, and one event can fan out to many functions

citations.quote: Each event can be used to start a workflow run
MCP events give both ends of the pipe a standard way to `.emit()` and `.subscribe()` to events without the need for an additional pub/sub service.
route webhook or polling events into notification signals
